integrity: The universal result is supported by an elementary mathematical proof; finite Python checks provide corroboration but do not prove unbounded genera. Same-model review only; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite-genus random reflective numerical semigroups only; maximal gap run through the genus pivot, not globally longest run. The pivot length is an immediate consequence of Shor’s published parametrization; the newly assessed work concerns the finite-genus divisor histogram, harmonic-step limit with effective CDF bound, and moments. Literature priority not independently certified.
title: A harmonic-step limit law for the genus-pivot gap in reflective numerical semigroups
